title: 1811 Prairie's stone dressing, downpipes and stair scrolls, from its 1888 plate
items: 1811 Prairie's bay is now rough rock-faced stone up to its first-floor windows and smooth dressed stone above, as the 1888 plate shows it, and two downpipes run down the front where the plate draws them.
The rolled stone scrolls at the foot of its front stair now sit up on plain blocks, as in the plate, instead of resting on the ground.
